of.needed: whether the environment has Go code that imports crossplane or crossplane-runtime as a module dependency

original.statement: The Go module path for Crossplane and Crossplane Runtime has changed from `github.com/crossplane/crossplane` and `github.com/crossplane/crossplane-runtime` to include a `v2` suffix: `github.com/crossplane/crossplane/v2` and `github.com/crossplane/crossplane-runtime/v2`; all import statements in code must be updated.

decision.reason: [ev-d241daaf3863] says exposure depends on whether someone's Go code imports `crossplane` or `crossplane-runtime` in `go.mod` and must move to the `/v2` module paths. That is a property of source code. It is not cluster configuration, and it is not runtime behaviour either. The proposed condition has three problems: its undecidable leaf uses an invalid reason ("cross-product-context-gap"), it treats Crossplane as another product to check with a `product-version` leaf, and `>=2.0.0` only repeats the release edge. Since no allowed predicate or undecidable reason fits source-code imports, applicability should be marked undetermined (as P1 did) rather than asserted, so no corrected exposure condition follows.
